description: We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) to lead operations at a premier health and rehabilitation center in Baltimore County, MD. This confidential opportunity offers a chance to make a significant impact on patient care and facility success. The ideal candidate will be a visionary leader committed to maintaining high standards of quality and compliance.In this pivotal role, you will oversee all aspects of facility management, ensuring efficient operations, exceptional patient outcomes, and a positive work environment. You will be responsible for strategic planning, financial management, regulatory compliance, and staff development. This is an excellent opportunity for an LNHA looking to join a supportive organization focused on delivering outstanding care.We are looking for a leader who can inspire a team and drive continuous improvement. If you are passionate about healthcare administration and ready for a challenging yet rewarding position, we encourage you to apply.
requirements: Active and unencumbered Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) license in Maryland.
Minimum of 3-5 years of experience as an LNHA in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation facility.
Demonstrated leadership abilities and strong operational management skills.
Thorough knowledge of state and federal regulations governing long-term care facilities.
Bachelor's degree in Healthcare Administration, Business Administration, or a related field.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation ranges from $115,000 to $145,000 per year, based on experience.

description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced MDS Coordinator (RN) to join a premier skilled nursing facility in Missouri Valley, IA. This full-time role offers a vital opportunity to ensure accurate resident assessments and care planning, contributing significantly to both resident well-being and facility operations. We are looking for a permanent team member, not an interim placement, who is ready to make a lasting impact.

As an MDS Coordinator, you will be responsible for the timely and accurate completion of the Minimum Data Set (MDS) assessments, ensuring compliance with federal and state regulations. Your expertise will be crucial in optimizing reimbursement and developing comprehensive care plans that reflect the unique needs of each resident. This position offers a competitive salary, commensurate with your experience and qualifications. Join a supportive environment where your skills are valued and your professional growth is encouraged.
requirements: Active and unrestricted Registered Nurse (RN) license.
Proven experience as an MDS Coordinator, proficient with MDS 3.0.
Strong understanding of Medicare and Medicaid regulations.
Excellent assessment, documentation, and communication skills.
Prior experience in a skilled nursing or long-term care setting.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation ranges from $65,000 to $75,000 annually, based on experience.

description:
We are seeking a dedicated Assistant Director of Nursing (ADON) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Frostburg, MD. This pivotal leadership role offers the opportunity to significantly impact patient care and operational excellence, working alongside a committed team to uphold the highest standards of service. If you are passionate about fostering a supportive environment and driving positive outcomes, this is an excellent opportunity to advance your career.

As an ADON, you will play a crucial role in supervising nursing staff, ensuring the delivery of exceptional patient care, and contributing to the overall success of the facility. We are particularly interested in candidates who are Registered Nurses, bringing a strong clinical background to this leadership position. This role offers a competitive salary range, reflecting the importance of your expertise and dedication.
requirements: Previous experience in a nursing leadership or supervisory role
Strong clinical assessment and critical thinking skills
Ability to effectively manage and mentor nursing staff
Commitment to providing high-quality patient care

description: We are urgently seeking a dedicated Registered Nurse (RN) for a full-time, 12-hour evening shift position in Red Bay, AL. requirements: Current and active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Alabama.
Minimum of 1-2 years of experience in a skilled nursing facility or long-term care setting.
